items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I worked with a guitar player, you see, Jiving Jim Jackson.

ctx.x: I took over for Step'n Fetchit. I took over for him on a medicine show. I worked with a guitar player, you see, Jiving Jim Jackson. He wrote a tune, "I'm Going to Move to Kansas City" and the other guitarist played a double guitar. I remember that, and we were out on a medicine show and we sold medicine, 50¢, a cure-all. I do remember this.

Hey, Jo, I want to play this record here now. This is a recording of without a doubt the greatest rhythm section that was ever put together and it consists of this - it's called the All-American Rhythm Section and it still is and always was and without a doubt recognized by the entire world as the greatest rhythm section that was ever in the music business and the dance band, and that's Jo Jones, Count Basie, Freddie Green, and the very great late Walter Page. Do you want to tell me anything about this first one,…
